 Polymarket Promo Code NOLA: FAQ 
 The frequently asked questions below explain exactly how to claim the promo code NOLA welcome offer. 
 What is the Polymarket promo code? 
 The promo code is NOLA. Applying this specific code during initial account registration activates a welcome offer where you deposit $10 at Polymarket and get a $25 bonus. This special promotion is exclusively available for new users establishing their first profile on the exchange. 
 How do you unlock the $25 Polymarket bonus? 
 The $25 bonus is unlocked after a $10 or more first-time deposit. Once your qualifying funds clear on the platform, the promotional credit is triggered automatically. The funds typically hit your available account balance within a 12- to 24-hour window, allowing you to begin placing trades.

 Polymarket is legally accessible to users aged 18 and older in the vast majority of the United States.
